additional_job_search_capabilities.capability: Applicant & Company Insights on Job Listings
additional_job_search_capabilities.details: Premium reveals how your skills compare against other applicants, total applicant count trends, company headcount growth, and hiring department patterns on https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/.

Setting 'Open to Work (Recruiters only)' plus matching headline/skills boosts visibility in LinkedIn Recruiter queries for UX Researcher, Data Analyst, Product Owner, and Digital Solution Architect roles.
Combine LinkedIn Jobs discovery with People search at target companies and InMail credits to message hiring managers directly with the matching GitHub Pages portfolio link.
Use LinkedIn AI Coaching (role-play) together with Granola Business (6 months free perk) to structure interview prep and post-interview follow-ups.

ai_job_search_context.purpose: Context for AI companions: LinkedIn is an active primary platform for job discovery, recruiter visibility, direct hiring-manager outreach, and interview preparation, powered by an active Premium Business subscription.
how_ai_should_use_linkedin: Treat LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/) as a first-class job-search channel alongside company career portals.

Leverage Premium Business features: AI Job Insights to tailor applications, InMail to contact recruiters/hiring managers directly, Profile Views to spot warm leads, and Network Introductions for referrals.
Align the LinkedIn Featured section and outreach messages with the user's 4 public GitHub Pages portfolios (ux-researcher, data-analyst, product-owner, digital-solution-architect).

Note that the Premium Business plan renews on 2026-12-15, so time-sensitive perks (Lovable, Granola Business, Notion Business, Headway) and active job-search campaigns can be maximized before renewal.
